study: MIST acting study inspired by Wallace & Gromit and Shaun the Sheep
post_processing: None. The original generated PNG was copied unchanged.

review.method: Visual inspection of the full generated sheet, followed by dimensions, SHA256 comparison, and selected background pixel samples from the unchanged saved copy.
review.overall: Accepted with notes. Nine cyan faces form three clear rows on a dark field. No text, frames, animal heads, bodies, props, or icons appear. The facial anchors remain visually stable within each row.

rows.setup: Round forward-looking eyes and a closed straight mouth.
rows.change: Pupils move right and one lifted brow/lid accent introduces alert attention.
rows.settle: Half-lowered lids soften the attentive hold while the mouth stays closed.
rows.assessment: The sequence reads as calm attention. The lifted lid includes a short separate brow accent.

rows.setup: Neutral circular eyes with a tiny flat mouth.
rows.change: One eye narrows while the other remains round; the pupils glance sideways.
rows.settle: Both eyes settle under nearly horizontal lids with the mouth held straight.
rows.assessment: The sequence is distinct at thumbnail scale. Rounded lower lids and a flat mouth keep it deadpan rather than angry.

rows.setup: Different eye heights and an off-centre gaze suggest puzzlement.
rows.change: Two closed curved eye strokes form a complete blink.
rows.settle: The eyes reopen together and the mouth becomes a small smile.
rows.assessment: The blink separates the beats clearly. The final pose reads as quiet satisfaction.

limitations: The background is visually near-uniform dark teal but does not match #101c20 at every pixel. Six sampled empty-background RGB values ranged from (16,29,32) to (17,32,34).
The rounded eye shapes are smoother and more graphic than a physical clay surface. The Aardman influence is expressed mainly through understated gaze, eyelids, asymmetry, and timing.
A separate cyan brow accent appears in the attentive change pose and a small brow-like edge appears in the puzzled setup.
Equal grid thirds and stable face anchors are visually respected; the generated drawing was not geometrically aligned or altered after generation.
